taylors_about_text: Established in 1969, Taylor's University is the No. 1 private university in Southeast Asia and ranked  globally in the QS World University Rankings 2025. Located in Subang Jaya, Selangor, its 27-acre Lakeside Campus integrates state-of-the-art research laboratories, modern student residences, and vibrant waterfront promenades. Taylor's offers an internationally benchmarked curriculum with global dual award degrees with leading UK, Australian, and French universities.
taylors_highlight_1_title: No. 1 Private University in Southeast Asia
taylors_highlight_1_desc: Ranked  globally in QS World University Rankings, leading private higher education across Southeast Asia.
taylors_highlight_2_desc: Direct dual degree partnerships with top universities in the UK, Australia, and France with international exchange options.
taylors_highlight_3_desc: 27-acre modern sustainable campus featuring cutting-edge innovation labs, digital studios, and on-campus residences.
taylors_highlight_4_desc: Industry-aligned syllabus, compulsory internships, and direct career networking with Fortune 500 multinationals.
guide_requirements_desc: Applicants require High School completion / Foundation / Diploma with satisfactory grades (equivalent to CGPA 2.50 - 3.00 depending on major). English requirements are IELTS 5.0 - 6.5 or equivalent. Students without official IELTS scores can take Taylor's English Placement Test and Intensive English Program (IEP).
guide_visa_desc: StudyCo provides 100% free end-to-end guidance for Malaysian Student Visa (EMGS) processing, university document preparation, medical checkups, and dedicated airport reception at Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KLIA).
guide_accommodation_desc: Taylor's Lakeside Campus features premium on-campus student housing (U-Residence & Ru-emz) with 24/7 security, high-speed Wi-Fi, swimming pool, gym, study lounges, and dining promenade. Multiple verified apartments are also available nearby in Subang Jaya.
taylors_faq_q1: Are Taylor's University degrees recognized globally?
taylors_faq_a1: Yes, all Taylor's University programs are fully accredited by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA) and the Ministry of Higher Education Malaysia (MOHE), and are recognized worldwide by leading professional bodies and international universities.
taylors_faq_q2: How do I receive a Free Offer Letter through StudyCo?
taylors_faq_a2: As an authorized official educational partner, StudyCo processes your admission directly with Taylor's University with zero agency fees and no application processing fee for partner programs.
taylors_faq_q3: Can I study at Taylor's if I do not have an IELTS certificate?
taylors_faq_a3: Yes. Students who do not meet the minimum IELTS requirement can take Taylor's University English Placement Test or enroll in Taylor's Intensive English Program (IEP) upon arrival.
taylors_faq_q4: What are the accommodation options at the Lakeside Campus?
taylors_faq_a4: Taylor's offers on-campus 5-star lakeside residences (single, twin, and en-suite rooms) managed by professional hospitality staff, along with numerous verified off-campus apartments in Subang Jaya and Bandar Sunway.
